svg.text: M1’s single-row pass gates every speculation milestone
M0 · Baselines
Bandwidth microbenchmark, agent replay harness, production and tuned SGLang profiled, BF16 reference
Every target below is restated against the measured bus and the tuned baseline
Gate: production’s step split; targets restated
M1 · Single-row fused path
Blob in tile order with the gated precision map, five kernels per layer, FP8 KV, one CUDA graph
Quality gate on the quantized model; greedy output matches the reference
Gate: 90% of the measured bus at 1 row; host under 1 ms
M2 · Exact speculation
Row buckets 16–64, DFlash2 with 16 drafts, DeltaNet replay, context-lookup branch
Exactness suite green for every bucket
Gate: greedy output identical; replay at 55 tokens/s
M3 · Fast speculation
32k-token draft head, drafter inside the step graph, lookup branch tuned on the replay
Acceptance measured by source on the replay, against production’s 4.87 per step
Gate: agent replay at 70 tokens/s or more
M4 · Product
Mightling’s endpoints and parsers, shared-prefix checkpoints, FP4 chunked prefill, images, batches of 2–4
Replay against production and tuned SGLang on the same box; warm requests ≤ 0.25 s
Gate: new session ≤ 1 s; 4 agents ≥ 175 tokens/s
M5 · Hardening
10-minute thermal runs, 262k context, 4-bit KV option, telemetry, agent-tuned drafter trial
Release manifest with precision map, template hash and Nsight traces
Gate: all three validation gates green; release
